segments.plan: Opening question card
segments.title: When a family pays for a party, who holds the money?
segments.subtitle: Example: {pot.name}, in NivPay

segments.plan: Phone A, Eddy: Make a pot, Mama's 60th, London, $500, invite Maya and Daniel, 2 of 3, Caterer up to $700, Event hall up to $300, Thu 31 Dec 2026
segments.caption: {cast.eddy.name} makes {pot.name}. Named people decide, {pot.rule}
segments.callout: It can only ever pay the {cast.caterer.name}, up to {cast.caterer.limit}, and the {cast.eventHall.name}, up to {cast.eventHall.limit}

segments.plan: Phone B: Maya, Daniel and the Event hall each open their invite and reply with a link
segments.caption: Everyone named replies with a link

segments.plan: Phone A: Everyone has replied, set shares $400 and $100, Make the pot, fingerprint, the lid drops and locks at Finalized
segments.caption: Made. It closes {pot.closesOn}
segments.callout: The rules are fixed the moment it is made

segments.plan: Phone A, Eddy: Pour in $500, the coin flies from London and lands at Finalized
segments.caption: {cast.eddy.name} pours in {pot.pours.eddy}

segments.plan: B: Maya pours in $400. A: Maya's coin arrives on Eddy's map within seconds
segments.caption: {cast.maya.name} pours in {pot.pours.maya} from {cast.maya.city}

segments.plan: Phone B, Daniel: Pour in $100, the pot holds $1,000
segments.caption: {cast.daniel.name} adds {pot.pours.daniel}. The pot holds {pot.total}

segments.plan: Phone B, Daniel: Ask for a payment, Caterer, $600: fee $3.00, left $397.00, 1 more yes pays Caterer, fingerprint
segments.caption: {cast.daniel.name} asks to pay the {cast.caterer.name} {pot.caterer.amount}
segments.callout: NivPay fee {pot.caterer.fee}, {pot.feeRate} of the payment, shown before anyone says yes

segments.plan: Phone B, Maya: Waiting for your yes, Say yes and pay Caterer, That's 2 of 3, the stream runs to the Caterer, the pot has $397.00
segments.caption: The second yes pays it, in the same step
segments.callout: Only to the {cast.caterer.name}. The pot holds {pot.caterer.after}

segments.plan: Phone A, Caterer: Receive, $600.00 under Payments in, From a NivPay pot
segments.caption: The {cast.caterer.name} gets exactly {pot.caterer.amount}

segments.plan: Phone B, Daniel: Ask for a payment, Event hall, $280: fee $1.40, left $115.60
segments.caption: Then the {cast.eventHall.name}, {pot.eventHall.amount}

segments.plan: Phone A, Eddy: Waiting for your yes, Say yes and pay Event hall, the pot has $115.60
segments.caption: {cast.eddy.name} says yes. {pot.left} is left

segments.plan: Phone A, Eddy: Closing and your share, Eddy $57.80, Maya $46.24, Daniel $11.56, You put in $500, half of the pot, Ask to close early
segments.caption: Close early: what is left is shared by what each put in
segments.callout: {cast.eddy.name} put in {pot.pours.eddy}, {pot.eddyFraction} the pot, so {pot.eddyFraction} of {pot.left}

segments.plan: Phone B, Maya: Say yes and close it, See the split: streams to each city, $1,000 went in, $880 paid out, $4.40 on fees
segments.caption: {pot.total} in. {pot.paidOut} paid out. {pot.fees} in fees

segments.plan: B: Maya, Take my $46.24, coin to Houston. A: Eddy, Take my $57.80, coin to London
segments.caption: Anyone can leave with their share

segments.plan: Phone B, Daniel: Take my $11.56, the pot holds $0.00
segments.caption: {cast.daniel.name} takes {pot.shares.daniel}. Nothing is left, to the cent

segments.plan: Phone A, Eddy: See the pot's story, then the replay button: the whole story in about 7 s
segments.caption: Every step, replayed

segments.caption: The contract on Monad that holds the pot we just made
segments.callout: Money goes only to the payees fixed when the pot was made

segments.caption: CreatePot: the pot we just made, {pot.name}
